SELECT COUNT(*) AS roots,COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(result_size,4194304)),0) AS bytes FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task}
mapper.update: UPDATE native_search_run SET phase='STARTED',process_identity=#{identity} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND phase='PREPARED'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin,phase,process_identity,storage_removed,result_hash,result_size,cursor_index,created_at,stopped_at,expires_at,record_version FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND task_id=#{task} AND effect_id=#{effect} AND worker_id=#{worker} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE native_search_run SET phase='STOPPED',process_identity=#{identity},stopped_at=COALESCE(stopped_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin,phase,process_identity,storage_removed,result_hash,result_size,cursor_index,created_at,stopped_at,expires_at,record_version FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE native_search_run SET result_hash=#{hash},result_size=#{size},cursor_index=#{cursors} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin,phase,process_identity,storage_removed,result_hash,result_size,cursor_index,created_at,stopped_at,expires_at,record_version FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND result_hash IS NOT NULL AND phase='STOPPED' AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

SELECT n.tenant_id,n.root_invocation,n.task_id,n.effect_id,n.attempt_id,n.worker_id,n.host_id,n.runtime_directory,n.snapshot_digest,n.query_digest,n.tool_pin,n.phase,n.process_identity,n.storage_removed,n.result_hash,n.result_size,n.cursor_index,n.created_at,n.stopped_at,n.expires_at,n.record_version, (t.state<>'RUNNING' OR t.deadline<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR t.lease_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR w.stopped=TRUE) AS stop_requested FROM native_search_run n JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND t.id=n.task_id JOIN worker_process w ON w.id=n.worker_id WHERE n.host_id=#{host} AND n.phase<>'STOPPED' ORDER BY n.root_invocation LIMIT 64

SELECT n.tenant_id,n.root_invocation,n.task_id,n.effect_id,n.attempt_id,n.worker_id,n.host_id,n.runtime_directory,n.snapshot_digest,n.query_digest,n.tool_pin,n.phase,n.process_identity,n.storage_removed,n.result_hash,n.result_size,n.cursor_index,n.created_at,n.stopped_at,n.expires_at,n.record_version FROM native_search_run n JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND t.id=n.task_id WHERE n.host_id=#{host} AND n.phase='STOPPED' AND n.storage_removed=FALSE AND n.expires_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND t.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','NEEDS_RECONCILIATION') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_attempt a WHERE a.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND a.task_id=n.task_id AND a.quiescent=FALSE) LIMIT 64

SELECT tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin,phase,process_identity,storage_removed,result_hash,result_size,cursor_index,created_at,stopped_at,expires_at,record_version FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND task_id=#{task} AND effect_id=#{effect} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE native_search_run SET storage_removed=TRUE,result_size=COALESCE(result_size,0) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation}
